title: AI context builder service — assemble project context for AI prompt injection
description: Create a service that assembles a concise, structured project context string for injection into AI prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: Includes: project name, type, vision (truncated), status, progress %, level, points

steps.details:
Create server/src/services/aiContextService.ts. Export async function buildProjectContext(projectId: string): Promise<string>. Fetch: project, milestones (top 5 by sort_order), last 3 journal entries (titles only), todo counts. Format as: 'Project: NAME (TYPE)
Vision: VISION
Status: STATUS | Progress: N%
Level: LEVEL (N pts)
Milestones: [list]
Recent journal: [titles]
Open todos: N'.
Call buildProjectContext with a well-populated project. Verify output is readable and under token limit. Verify it includes all key fields.
